title: QM-like Projection Domain Registry
purpose: Define the governed feature space for QM-like projection analogs including distinction, discreteness, exclusion, participation, threshold behavior, and local admissibility structure without claiming derivation of quantum mechanics.

domain_definition.canonical_statement: QM-like projection domains are projection-derived analog structures emphasizing distinction, exclusion, discreteness, participation thresholds, and local admissibility behavior.
domain_definition.non_identity_rule: QM-like projection domains are not quantum mechanics and may not be promoted to physical interpretation.

governed_feature_classes.name: distinction_density
governed_feature_classes.definition: Projection emphasis on locally admissible distinguishability patterns.

governed_feature_classes.name: exclusion_gating
governed_feature_classes.definition: Projection emphasis on bounded admissibility through exclusion-like filtering.

governed_feature_classes.name: participation_thresholding
governed_feature_classes.definition: Projection emphasis on local participation constraints and threshold activation.

governed_feature_classes.name: discrete_transition_readability
governed_feature_classes.definition: Projection readability favoring bounded transition-like structures.

governed_feature_classes.name: local_orientation_selection
governed_feature_classes.definition: Projection emphasis on locally admissible orientation consistency.

governed_feature_classes.name: bounded_resolution_floor
governed_feature_classes.definition: Projection emphasis on non-zero admissibility floors preventing exact null realization.

allowed_uses: Comparing local participation structures against GR-like domains.
forbidden_uses: Claiming derivation of wavefunctions, Hilbert spaces, or physical quantum theory.
Treating exclusion-gating as physical measurement theory.
Promoting projection thresholds into physical constants.
Using QM-like projections as proof of reality.

governance_rules.rule: QM-like projection structures remain subordinate to ⇔R source relations.
QM-like structures must declare projection depth and recoverability class.
QM-like projection agreement cannot be treated as evidence for quantum mechanics.
Bounded resolution floors remain projection-derived admissibility constructs.
All QM-like artifacts remain ANALOG_ONLY and NON_PHYSICAL.
